mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in two months indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wages and inflationary pressures, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% over 3 months) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals a supportive monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth < 1% in 3 months and FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the previous quarter signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which is a positive indicator for consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over two months signals a weakening consumer demand, which can lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
